import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedFreeRenaming

/-!
Represented finite sequent images for the internal two-counter free renaming.
The total image graph is fixed before the arithmetic model. Constructor and
SHIFT image laws retain actual formula-set premises where syntax laws need
well-formed inputs. No source derivation is translated by this module.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedRenamingSets
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedFreeRenaming
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

lemma setRename_existsUnique (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (chosen level offset sequence : V) :
    ∃! out : V, ∀ y, y ∈ out ↔ ∃ x ∈ sequence, y = rename L chosen level offset x :=
  sigma₁_replacement (by definability) sequence

noncomputable def setRename (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (chosen level offset sequence : V) : V :=
  Classical.choose! (setRename_existsUnique L chosen level offset sequence)
noncomputable def setRenameDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 5 := .mkSigma “out chosen level offset sequence.
      (∀ y ∈' out, ∃ x ∈' sequence, !(renameDef L) y chosen level offset x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈' sequence, ∃ y, !(renameDef L) y chosen level offset x ∧ y ∈ out)”

lemma mem_setRename_iff (chosen level offset : V) {sequence y : V} :
    y ∈ setRename L chosen level offset sequence ↔
      ∃ x ∈ sequence, y = rename L chosen level offset x :=
  Classical.choose!_spec (setRename_existsUnique L chosen level offset sequence) y
lemma rename_mem_setRename (chosen level offset : V) {sequence p : V} (hp : p ∈ sequence) :
    rename L chosen level offset p ∈ setRename L chosen level offset sequence :=
  mem_setRename_iff chosen level offset |>.mpr ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩

private lemma setRename_graph (chosen level offset out sequence : V) :
    out = setRename L chosen level offset sequence ↔
      (∀ y ∈ out, ∃ x ∈ sequence, y = rename L chosen level offset x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ sequence, rename L chosen level offset x ∈ out) := by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨fun _ hy => (mem_setRename_iff chosen level offset).mp hy,
      fun _ hx => rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨hforward,hback⟩
    apply mem_ext
    intro y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      exact (mem_setRename_iff chosen level offset).mpr (hforward y hy)
    · intro hy
      rcases (mem_setRename_iff chosen level offset).mp hy with ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
      exact hback x hx
instance setRename_defined :
    𝚺₁-Function₄[V] (setRename L) via setRenameDef L := .mk fun e => by
  simp [setRenameDef,setRename_graph]
instance setRename_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₄[V] (setRename L) :=
  setRename_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

lemma setRename_isFormulaSet (chosen level offset : V) {sequence : V}
    (hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence) :
    IsFormulaSet L (setRename L chosen level offset sequence) := by
  intro p hp
  rcases (mem_setRename_iff chosen level offset).mp hp with ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
  exact rename_isSemiformula chosen level offset (hs q hq)

  apply mem_ext
  intro y
  simp [mem_setRename_iff]
@[simp] lemma setRename_insert (chosen level offset p sequence : V) :

  apply mem_ext
  intro y
  simp [mem_setRename_iff]
lemma setRename_subset (chosen level offset : V) {sequence target : V}

  intro y hy
  rcases (mem_setRename_iff chosen level offset).mp hy with ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
  exact rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset (h hx)

lemma setRename_shift_lift (chosen level offset : V) {sequence : V}
    (hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence) :
    setRename L chosen (level+1) offset (setShift L sequence) =
      setShift L (setRename L chosen level offset sequence) := by
  apply mem_ext
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    rcases (mem_setRename_iff chosen (level+1) offset).mp hy with ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
    rcases mem_setShift_iff.mp hq with ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
    exact mem_setShift_iff.mpr ⟨rename L chosen level offset p,
      rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hp,
      rename_shift_lift chosen level offset (hs p hp).isUFormula⟩
  · intro hy
    rcases mem_setShift_iff.mp hy with ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
    rcases (mem_setRename_iff chosen level offset).mp hq with ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
    exact (mem_setRename_iff chosen (level+1) offset).mpr
      ⟨shift L p,shift_mem_setShift hp,
        (rename_shift_lift chosen level offset (hs p hp).isUFormula).symm⟩
lemma setRename_shift_offset (chosen offset : V) {sequence : V}
    (hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence) :
    setRename L chosen 0 offset (setShift L sequence) =
      setRename L chosen 0 (offset+1) sequence := by
  apply mem_ext
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    rcases (mem_setRename_iff chosen 0 offset).mp hy with ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
    rcases mem_setShift_iff.mp hq with ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
    exact (mem_setRename_iff chosen 0 (offset+1)).mpr
      ⟨p,hp,rename_shift_offset chosen offset (hs p hp).isUFormula⟩
  · intro hy
    rcases (mem_setRename_iff chosen 0 (offset+1)).mp hy with ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
    exact (mem_setRename_iff chosen 0 offset).mpr
      ⟨shift L p,shift_mem_setShift hp,
        (rename_shift_offset chosen offset (hs p hp).isUFormula).symm⟩

lemma rename_substs1 (chosen level offset : V) {p term : V}
    (hp : IsSemiformula L 1 p) (ht : IsTerm L term) :
    rename L chosen level offset (substs1 L term p) =
      substs1 L (termRename L chosen level offset term) (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  unfold substs1
  rw [rename_subst chosen level offset hp 0 (term ∷ 0) (by simp [ht]),
    termRenameVec_singleton chosen level offset ht.isUTerm]

end LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedRenamingSets

variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

private lemma budget_mono {child parent level newLevel offset newOffset total : V}
    (hc : child ≤ parent) (hk : newLevel ≤ level) (ho : newOffset ≤ offset)
    (hb : parent+level+offset ≤ total) : child+newLevel+newOffset ≤ total :=
  le_trans (add_le_add (add_le_add hc hk) ho) hb
private lemma budget_lift {child parent level offset total : V}
    (hc : child < parent) (hb : parent+level+offset ≤ total) :
    child+(level+1)+offset ≤ total := by
  calc
    child+(level+1)+offset = (child+1)+level+offset := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ parent+level+offset := add_le_add_right
      (add_le_add_right (lt_iff_succ_le.mp hc) level) offset
    _ ≤ total := hb
private lemma budget_offset {child parent level offset total : V}
    (hc : child < parent) (hb : parent+level+offset ≤ total) :
    child+level+(offset+1) ≤ total := by
  calc
    child+level+(offset+1) = (child+1)+level+offset := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ parent+level+offset := add_le_add_right
      (add_le_add_right (lt_iff_succ_le.mp hc) level) offset
    _ ≤ total := hb
private lemma level_le_budget (proof level offset : V) : level ≤ proof+level+offset := by
  have h : level ≤ proof+level := by simp
  exact le_trans h (by simp)
private lemma offset_le_budget (proof level offset : V) : offset ≤ proof+level+offset := by
  simp

/-- Only bounded counter quantifiers occur in the actual induction predicate. -/
theorem derivable_rename_bounded (chosen total : V)

    ∀ d : V, Derivation T d → ∀ level ≤ total, ∀ offset ≤ total,
      d+level+offset ≤ total →
      Derivable T (setRename L chosen level offset (fstIdx d)) := by
  apply ISigma1.sigma1_order_induction (P := fun d : V =>
    Derivation T d → ∀ level ≤ total, ∀ offset ≤ total,
      d+level+offset ≤ total →
      Derivable T (setRename L chosen level offset (fstIdx d)))
  · apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.imp (by definability)
    apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.ball_le (by definability)
    apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.ball_le (by definability)
    apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.imp (by definability)
    definability
  · intro d ih hd level hk offset ho hb
    rcases hd.case with ⟨hseq,
      (⟨sequence,p,rfl,hp,hnp⟩ | ⟨sequence,rfl,hp⟩ |
       ⟨sequence,p,q,dp,dq,rfl,hpq,hdp,hdq⟩ |
       ⟨sequence,p,q,dp,rfl,hpq,hdp⟩ |
       ⟨sequence,p,dp,rfl,hp,hdp⟩ |
       ⟨sequence,p,term,dp,rfl,hp,ht,hdp⟩ |
       ⟨sequence,dp,rfl,hsub,hdp⟩ |
       ⟨sequence,dp,rfl,hsequence,hdp⟩ |
       ⟨sequence,p,dp,dn,rfl,hdp,hdn⟩ |
       ⟨sequence,p,rfl,hp,hT⟩)⟩
    · have hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence := by simpa only [fstIdx_axL] using hseq
      have hm : neg L (rename L chosen level offset p) ∈
          setRename L chosen level offset sequence := by
        rw [←rename_neg chosen level offset (hs p hp).isUFormula]
        exact rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hnp
      simpa only [fstIdx_axL] using Derivable.em
        (setRename_isFormulaSet chosen level offset hs)
        (rename L chosen level offset p) (rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hp) hm
    · have hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence := by simpa only [fstIdx_verumIntro] using hseq
      have hm : ^⊤ ∈ setRename L chosen level offset sequence := by
        simpa only [rename_verum] using rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hp
      simpa only [fstIdx_verumIntro] using
        Derivable.verum (setRename_isFormulaSet chosen level offset hs) hm
    · have hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence := by simpa only [fstIdx_andIntro] using hseq
      have hparts : IsFormula L p ∧ IsFormula L q := IsSemiformula.and.mp (hs _ hpq)
      have ihp := ih dp (dp_lt_andIntro sequence p q dp dq) hdp.2 level hk offset ho
        (budget_mono (le_of_lt (dp_lt_andIntro sequence p q dp dq)) le_rfl le_rfl hb)
      have ihq := ih dq (dq_lt_andIntro sequence p q dp dq) hdq.2 level hk offset ho
        (budget_mono (le_of_lt (dq_lt_andIntro sequence p q dp dq)) le_rfl le_rfl hb)
      rw [hdp.1,setRename_insert] at ihp
      rw [hdq.1,setRename_insert] at ihq
      have hm : (rename L chosen level offset p ^⋏ rename L chosen level offset q) ∈
          setRename L chosen level offset sequence := by
        rw [←rename_and chosen level offset hparts.1.isUFormula hparts.2.isUFormula]
        exact rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hpq
      simpa only [fstIdx_andIntro] using Derivable.and_m hm ihp ihq
    · have hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence := by simpa only [fstIdx_orIntro] using hseq
      have hparts : IsFormula L p ∧ IsFormula L q := IsSemiformula.or.mp (hs _ hpq)
      have ihp := ih dp (d_lt_orIntro sequence p q dp) hdp.2 level hk offset ho
        (budget_mono (le_of_lt (d_lt_orIntro sequence p q dp)) le_rfl le_rfl hb)
      rw [hdp.1,setRename_insert,setRename_insert] at ihp
      have hm : (rename L chosen level offset p ^⋎ rename L chosen level offset q) ∈
          setRename L chosen level offset sequence := by
        rw [←rename_or chosen level offset hparts.1.isUFormula hparts.2.isUFormula]
        exact rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hpq
      simpa only [fstIdx_orIntro] using Derivable.or_m hm ihp
    · have hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence := by simpa only [fstIdx_allIntro] using hseq
      have hp1 : IsSemiformula L 1 p := by simpa using hs _ hp
      have hchild : dp+(level+1)+offset ≤ total :=
        budget_lift (s_lt_allIntro sequence p dp) hb
      have hk' : level+1 ≤ total := le_trans (level_le_budget dp (level+1) offset) hchild
      have ihp := ih dp (s_lt_allIntro sequence p dp) hdp.2 (level+1) hk' offset ho hchild
      rw [hdp.1,setRename_insert,rename_free_lift chosen level offset hp1,
        setRename_shift_lift chosen level offset hs] at ihp
      have hm : ^∀ (rename L chosen level offset p) ∈
          setRename L chosen level offset sequence := by
        rw [←rename_all chosen level offset hp1.isUFormula]
        exact rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hp
      simpa only [fstIdx_allIntro] using Derivable.all_m hm ihp
    · have hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence := by simpa only [fstIdx_exsIntro] using hseq
      have hp1 : IsSemiformula L 1 p := by simpa using hs _ hp
      have ihp := ih dp (d_lt_exsIntro sequence p term dp) hdp.2 level hk offset ho
        (budget_mono (le_of_lt (d_lt_exsIntro sequence p term dp)) le_rfl le_rfl hb)
      rw [hdp.1,setRename_insert,rename_substs1 chosen level offset hp1 ht] at ihp
      have hm : ^∃ (rename L chosen level offset p) ∈
          setRename L chosen level offset sequence := by
        rw [←rename_exs chosen level offset hp1.isUFormula]
        exact rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hp
      simpa only [fstIdx_exsIntro] using Derivable.ex_m hm
        (termRename_isSemiterm chosen level offset ht) ihp
    · have hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence := by simpa only [fstIdx_wkRule] using hseq
      have ihp := ih dp (d_lt_wkRule sequence dp) hdp level hk offset ho
        (budget_mono (le_of_lt (d_lt_wkRule sequence dp)) le_rfl le_rfl hb)
      simpa only [fstIdx_wkRule] using Derivable.wk
        (setRename_isFormulaSet chosen level offset hs)
        (setRename_subset chosen level offset hsub) ihp
    · rcases zero_or_succ level with rfl | ⟨level,rfl⟩
      · have hchild : dp+0+(offset+1) ≤ total :=
          budget_offset (d_lt_shiftRule sequence dp) hb
        have ho' : offset+1 ≤ total := le_trans (offset_le_budget dp 0 (offset+1)) hchild
        have ihp := ih dp (d_lt_shiftRule sequence dp) hdp 0 (by simp) (offset+1) ho' hchild
        simpa only [fstIdx_shiftRule,hsequence,
          setRename_shift_offset chosen offset hdp.isFormulaSet] using ihp

        simpa only [fstIdx_shiftRule,hsequence,
          setRename_shift_lift chosen level offset hdp.isFormulaSet] using hshift

        (budget_mono (le_of_lt (d₁_lt_cutRule sequence p dp dn)) le_rfl le_rfl hb)
      have ihn := ih dn (d₂_lt_cutRule sequence p dp dn) hdn.2 level hk offset ho
        (budget_mono (le_of_lt (d₂_lt_cutRule sequence p dp dn)) le_rfl le_rfl hb)
      rw [hdp.1,setRename_insert] at ihp
      rw [hdn.1,setRename_insert,rename_neg chosen level offset hp0.isUFormula] at ihn
      simpa only [fstIdx_cutRule] using Derivable.cut (rename L chosen level offset p) ihp ihn
    · have hs : IsFormulaSet L sequence := by simpa only [fstIdx_axm] using hseq
      simpa only [fstIdx_axm] using Derivable.by_axm
        (setRename_isFormulaSet chosen level offset hs)
        (rename L chosen level offset p) (rename_mem_setRename chosen level offset hp)
        (hAx level offset p (hs p hp) hT)

/-- The budget is chosen from the supplied arbitrary internal proof code. -/
theorem derivable_rename (chosen : V)
    (hAx : ∀ level offset p : V, IsFormula L p → p ∈ T.Δ₁Class →
      rename L chosen level offset p ∈ T.Δ₁Class)
    {d : V} (hd : Derivation T d) :
    Derivable T (setRename L chosen 0 0 (fstIdx d)) :=
  derivable_rename_bounded chosen d hAx d hd 0 (by simp) 0 (by simp) (by simp)

theorem provable_rename (chosen : V)
    (hAx : ∀ level offset p : V, IsFormula L p → p ∈ T.Δ₁Class →
      rename L chosen level offset p ∈ T.Δ₁Class)
    {p : V} (hp : Provable T p) : Provable T (rename L chosen 0 0 p) := by
  rcases hp.toDerivable with ⟨d,hd⟩
  have h := derivable_rename chosen hAx hd.2
  rw [hd.1,setRename_insert,setRename_empty] at h
  exact h.toProvable

/-- Actual ZF proof renaming has no remaining axiom-closure hypothesis. -/
theorem zf_provable_rename (chosen : V) {p : V} (hp : Provable (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory) p) :
    Provable (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory) (rename ℒₛₑₜ chosen 0 0 p) :=
  provable_rename chosen (fun level offset p hf hT => zf_rename_mem chosen level offset hf hT) hp
/-- Actual ZFC proof renaming has no remaining axiom-closure hypothesis. -/
theorem zfc_provable_rename (chosen : V) {p : V} (hp : Provable (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory) p) :
    Provable (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory) (rename ℒₛₑₜ chosen 0 0 p) :=
  provable_rename chosen (fun level offset p hf hT => zfc_rename_mem chosen level offset hf hT) hp

private lemma provable_namedAll_of_renamed {p : V} (chosen : V) (hp : IsFormula L p)
    (h : Provable T (rename L chosen 0 0 p)) : Provable T (namedAll L chosen p) := by
  have hbody := bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen
  have hfree : Derivable T (insert (free L (bindOneAt L chosen 0 p)) (∅ : V)) := by
    rw [free_bindOneAt hp chosen]
    exact h.toDerivable
  have hall : Derivable T (insert (^∀ (bindOneAt L chosen 0 p)) (∅ : V)) := by
    apply Derivable.all hbody
    simpa only [setShift_empty] using hfree
  exact hall.toProvable

/-- Named GEN for all internal ZF formulas, including formulas containing free zero. -/
theorem zf_provable_namedAll (chosen : V) {p : V} (hp : Provable (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory) p) :
    Provable (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory) (namedAll ℒₛₑₜ chosen p) := by
  have hf : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p := hp.toDerivable.isFormulaSet p (by simp)
  exact provable_namedAll_of_renamed chosen hf (zf_provable_rename chosen hp)
/-- Named GEN for all internal ZFC formulas, with no closed-matrix premise. -/
theorem zfc_provable_namedAll (chosen : V) {p : V} (hp : Provable (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory) p) :
    Provable (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory) (namedAll ℒₛₑₜ chosen p) := by
  have hf : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p := hp.toDerivable.isFormulaSet p (by simp)
  exact provable_namedAll_of_renamed chosen hf (zfc_provable_rename chosen hp)

  have hbody := bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen
  have hfree : Derivable T (insert (free L (bindOneAt L chosen 0 p)) (∅ : V)) := by

    exact h.toDerivable
  have hall : Derivable T (insert (^∀ (bindOneAt L chosen 0 p)) (∅ : V)) := by

  exact hall.toProvable

    Provable (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory) (namedAll ℒₛₑₜ chosen p) := by
  have hf : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p := hp.toDerivable.isFormulaSet p (by simp)

    Provable (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory) (namedAll ℒₛₑₜ chosen p) := by
  have hf : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p := hp.toDerivable.isFormulaSet p (by simp)

# Internal proof renaming and GEN: source-first checkpoint

Both modules and focused audits are written without admissions. They have not
been compiled. The only executed check is Sets prepare-only, which validates
predecessor/source/audit/provider identities and queries the compiler version;
it performs no proof compilation. BIC owns the sole compiler slot.

`ModelCodedRenamingSets` supplies the total finite image of the checked
renaming operation. Actual IΣ1 HFS Σ1 replacement proves a unique image set.
Its fixed Σ1 graph is defined before the arithmetic model, and its totality
supplies Δ1 definability. Raw images require no typing premise; formula-set
preservation and the SHIFT image laws use exactly the syntax premises they
need. Empty/insert/subset laws and a single-term opening law are included.

`ModelCodedProofRenaming` writes the complete ten-rule proof argument. For
fixed internal chosen,total the induction predicate at proof code d is

    Derivation T d ->
      forall k <= total, forall s <= total, d+k+s <= total ->
        Derivable T (setRename(chosen,k,s,fstIdx d)).

This is a Σ1 predicate. The source derivation predicate is Δ1, the target
existential proof predicate is Σ1, the image graph is total Δ1, and both
changing counters have bounded universal quantifiers. Only the fixed
chosen,total are unbounded parameters of that instance. No Π2 induction or
bound on the output proof code is used.

Each actual child proof code is strictly less than the parent. Its successor
is therefore at most the parent and pays for either ALL's k+1 or SHIFT at
level zero's s+1. Positive-level SHIFT uses k-1 and a target SHIFT. The ALL
premise is transported by the separately checked free/SHIFT laws. ∃ retains
a typed renamed witness term and the exact substitution law. Excluded
middle/cut use negation commutation; all remaining cases use the actual
finite-image constructor/inclusion laws. Axiom leaves use an explicit
syntactic closure premise only in the generic helper. Actual ZF/ZFC
corollaries discharge that premise with the already checked literal Δ1
axiom invariance.

At the root total=d,k=s=0. Thus arbitrary internal proofs, rather than only
quotations of ordinary derivations, are the intended input. The final
corollaries apply the checked identity

    free(bindOneAt(chosen,0,p)) = rename(chosen,0,0,p)

and the actual target ALL rule to obtain `Provable ZF (namedAll chosen p)`
from `Provable ZF p`, likewise for ZFC. Literal decoder truth with free label
zero is permitted. The source contains no standard-code, freshness,
shift-fixed-matrix, finite external proof, or selector hypothesis in these
actual-theory corollaries.

This is not yet a checked theorem. It also does not translate C254 rows,
construct a represented proof-code selector, or claim a PA consistency
endpoint. The source and selected audits are exact prebuild candidates.
The first guard checks Sets only (10 probes/10 callers); the proof guard
requires a genuine Sets PASS and reuses its exact object together with the
three checked renaming modules (7 probes/8 callers). It deliberately cannot
preflight with fabricated source-proof evidence.
